verdict.rationale: Daytona documents an official CLI that gives command-line access to core features, including sandbox lifecycle and snapshot management, and a probe confirms the dedicated CLI docs page. Its official agent skill also includes CLI references, which supports AI-native use. Missing for 10: detailed command-reference evidence beyond a one-line summary, explicit agent-oriented CLI features such as machine-readable output, and independent hands-on corroboration of the current CLI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Daytona provides command-line access to core features for interacting with Daytona Sandboxes, including managing their lifecycle, snapshots, and more.
Includes references and practical patterns for the Daytona API, CLI, Python, TypeScript, Go, and Ruby SDKs.
